html:
A Greek historian from Caesarea in Palestine, the main source for the reign of Justinian I. From 527 he served the general Belisarius as legal adviser and secretary, and went with him to the wars in Persia, Africa and Italy.

He wrote three very different books:

  • The History of the Wars, eight books on the Persian, Vandal and Gothic wars, modelled on Thucydides and based largely on what he saw.
  • The Buildings, a work of praise for Justinian's churches, forts and aqueducts.
  • The Secret History, a bitter private attack on Justinian, Theodora, Belisarius and his wife.

He gave a vivid eyewitness account of the plague in Constantinople in 542 and of the Nika riots. The clash between his public and secret books makes him one of the most debated writers of late antiquity.
